articles.title: Lamine Yamal hilariously trolls Nico Williams
articles.summary: Lamine Yamal knows how to have fun, and he proved it during the international break by teasing his friend Nico Williams. While the two were riding in a small shuttle, Yamal noticed Nico had a noticeably sweaty armpit and quickly turned the moment into a joke. He posted the clip to Instagram and tagged AXE, giving the deodorant brand an unexpected shoutout. The video quickly went viral, with fans loving the perfectly timed prank and another glimpse at the playful friendship between the two Spanish stars.

articles.title: Emergency summit over the Cristiano mess: intervention by the Portuguese Federation
articles.standfirst: The forward met on Tuesday night with Jorge Jesus and the federation president to try to put out the fire after being benched
articles.summary: The forward met on Tuesday night with Jorge Jesus and the federation president to try to put out the fire after being benched
articles.body:
Jorge Jesus and Cristiano Ronaldo met on Tuesday night at the Portuguese national team's training camp hotel in Malmö (Sweden).

The meeting, confirmed by A Bola, served to address the situation that arose after the last match against Norway . According to what this Portuguese newspaper learned, the conversation between the national team coach and the Portuguese captain took place in a positive manner and left favorable impressions, with the intention of easing the tension that has settled within the national team.

The origin of the unrest lies in the decision to leave Cristiano Ronaldo on the bench throughout the match played in Oslo . At first, the striker was informed that he would not get any minutes in that match. Later, Jorge Jesus told him that the plan was to bring him on in the second half for approximately half an hour. Ronaldo even went through warm-up exercises, but in the end he did not step onto the pitch . After the final whistle, the Portuguese star clearly showed his anger and headed straight for the dressing room.

Since then, Cristiano has not taken part in training with the group and has only worked in the gym. His situation has caused some unease within the national team and has once again brought to the table the debate about his role as the team's captain.

The matter was addressed directly by Cristiano Ronaldo and Jorge Jesus on Tuesday night, while Pedro Proença , president of the Portuguese Federation, who had planned to travel to the Azores to watch the under-21 national team face Gibraltar , chose to remain in Copenhagen to deal with the situation involving the senior national team, which will face Denmark tomorrow on matchday three of the Nations League.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal's training camp!!!
articles.standfirst: After Jorge Jesus's words denying any problem
articles.summary: After Jorge Jesus's words denying any problem
articles.body:
Bombshell from Denmark: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal’s training camp and will board his private plane to Madrid in a matter of hours. The captain and great icon of the Portuguese national team is leaving after his coach’s comments about his absence from the matches against Norway and Denmark. An early goodbye to this UEFA Nations League break (there were two matches left) that could be CR7’s final farewell to the Portuguese national team.

A situation that escalated in a matter of minutes shortly after Jorge Jesus, Portugal’s current national team coach and his former manager at Al Nassr (with whom he won the Saudi league), said there was no problem whatsoever with CR7.

What's more, he had even stated that he would train today in Copenhagen: "Yesterday he did not refuse to train. Francisco Conceição did not train due to injury, nor did Félix, because we were trying to ease the fatigue, and Cristiano Ronaldo did gym work. He will train today. It is the fourth day, so he will train." But no. The captain left Parken in a black van belonging to the Portuguese Football Federation.

If I need you for 30 minutes, you will play; if not, you won't. No player will make me change my mind

'Jorge Jesus, moreover, had confirmed a meeting with Cristiano last night, Tuesday, but made it clear that everything had been resolved before dinner time. However, he made his position of authority at the helm of the national team very clear: "I can promise whatever I want. I am the coach. I am the coach, I told the player that he was not going to play. I will put you on the bench. If I need you for 30 minutes, you will play; if not, you will not. No player will make me change my mind. Not him, nor anyone in football. Nor any president. Never, absolutely nobody".'

The origin of the controversy

Everything started a few days ago, in Oslo. Specifically during the Norway 1-2 Portugal Nations League match. Cristiano started on the bench and Jorge Jesus handed the starting spots to Joao Félix and Gonçalo Ramos. It worked out well for him because both scored and the team won... but that was when the crisis began.

The Portuguese captain remained on the bench throughout the entire match, except for moments in the second half when he was warming up... but he ended up without any minutes. After the victory, CR7 headed immediately to the dressing room and did not join the other substitutes in training the following day. Something that Jorge Jesus justified a few hours ago as something "usual" for the man from Madeira.

But what raised all the alarms in Portugal was the change of plans and trip by Pedro Proença, president of the Portuguese Football Federation, to meet in Copenhagen with the Portuguese star and national team coach Jorge Jesus. A meeting that took place this Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's statement about his departure: "In due time, I will tell the truth..."
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese has confirmed it on his social media
articles.summary: The Portuguese has confirmed it on his social media
articles.body:
While his private jet flies to Copenhagen and he waits in Denmark to fly to Madrid, Cristiano Ronaldo issued a statement about his decision to leave the Portugal national team camp on the eve of the Nations League match against Denmark.

The statement from Cristiano Ronaldo:

After the national team's coach's press conference, and following a conversation with the president of the Portuguese Football Federation, I decided to leave the national team's training camp.

In due course I will tell all the Portuguese the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the national team to which I always devoted myself

' In due time I will tell all Portuguese people the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the National Team, to which I always devoted myself. Now is the time to wish Portugal and all my teammates, without exception, good luck".'

Despite the words of CR7, Portugal's all-time top scorer and the footballer with the most international caps, the Portuguese is not referring to a definitive farewell to the National Team... simply to this break of four Nations League matches.

Let's remember that the man from Madeira left Copenhagen's Parken just a few minutes after the conclusion of a Jorge Jesus press conference in which the national team coach had stated that there was no problem with the player.

articles.title: The reasons behind Cristiano's anger with Jorge Jesus: will this be his farewell to Portugal?
articles.standfirst: MARCA reveals to you the minute-by-minute breakdown of the falling-out between player and coach
articles.summary: MARCA reveals to you the minute-by-minute breakdown of the falling-out between player and coach
articles.body:
Cristiano was not just anyone, and it is being proven. Jorge Jesus, despite everything and all the rumors that existed, decided to call him up for these four matches . But what has made Cristiano Ronaldo angry? What has the chronology of events been like? Could these be Cris's final hours with his country?

1. Jorge Jesus calls up Cristiano and they agree that number 7 would play the first match (Wales, 1-0) and the fourth (against Norway on October 4). So far, so good, and Cris started against Wales, playing the first 66 minutes, scoring a goal... but it was disallowed. So far, everything was fine.

'2. On the morning of the second match against Norway (1-2), Jorge Jesus changes his mind and tells Cristiano that he needs him for that match and that he might give him the last half hour of the game. What happens? The match was 1-1 in the 51st minute with a goal by Haaland. Cris starts warming up, Portugal goes 1-2 up in the 54th minute, and the match situation no longer allows the No. 7 to play because they have to hold on to the result. He warms up for half an hour, does not come on, and leaves the stadium angry.'

3. He does not train before the match and goes to the hotel. Cristiano, yesterday Tuesday, did not train with the group in Denmark and goes to the hotel while the training session takes place. He trains alone in the gym.

' 4. JJ's press conference makes Cris explode. The star listens to his coach's press conference, his explanations do not convince him -"it's a moment of frustration that lasts 10, 15 or 20 seconds," JJ said- and, far from training with the group, he leaves the training camp. He will take his private plane to Madrid, and will arrive tonight.'

5. Will it be his farewell to the National Team? Hard to know now, since this is all very recent. But the 146 goals in 234 matches by the No. 7 may have come to an end in Portugal.
